title: Clan Primer global rules (hcomg, menuhandbook.bin)

container.notes: Little-endian, magic 'hcomg\0\0\0'. Fixed 0x3C-byte head (magic, link, map count 384, 48-byte cartographer bitmap), then a chain of four blocks: Scrivener (0x3C), Hunts, Defeated-foe figures (24 bytes), Figure parameters. Every block starts with a u16 = distance from that u16 to the next block; the last block's u16 is the distance to the end of data before padding. Hunt list padded to 4; file zero-padded to 16.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: 68 63 6F 6D 67 00 00 00 ('hcomg' + 3 zero bytes).

fields.name: scrivenerBlockLink
fields.notes: Scrivener block at 0x08 + value (0x34 -> 0x3C).

fields.name: cartographerMapCount
fields.notes: 384; fixed in the executable, ignored by the reader. Keep it unchanged.

fields.name: cartographerMapBits
fields.notes: Map i required for the Cartographer figure when bit (i % 8) of byte (i / 8) is set. See hcomgCartographerMapByte for a bit view.

records.name: hcomgCartographerMapByte
records.where: file offset 0x0C; byte j at 0x0C + j covers maps 8j .. 8j+7

fields.name: huntBlockLink
fields.notes: Hunt block at S + value; = 8 + 4*ruleCount.

fields.name: requiredFoeCount
fields.notes: Bestiary entries required for the Scrivener figure (max 512).

fields.name: unused
fields.notes: Skipped; written 0. Keep it unchanged.

fields.name: ruleCount
fields.notes: Number of hcomgScrivenerRule records that follow.

bits.name: viewedBestiaryId
bits.notes: Bestiary entry this rule applies to.

fields.name: requirementValue
fields.notes: Type 0: required story progress. Type 1: required bestiary id.

fields.name: defeatedFoeBlockLink
fields.notes: Defeated-foe block at H + value; = align4(4 + 2*huntCount).

records.name: hcomgHuntRule
records.where: H + 4; rule i at H + 4 + 2*i; list zero-padded to 4

fields.name: questId
fields.notes: Hunt / quest number (numbering space unverified).

fields.name: requiredQuestStage
fields.notes: Stage the hunt must reach to count for the clan rank.

fields.name: figureBlockLink
fields.notes: Distance from this u16 to the figure parameter block (24 when rebuilt).

fields.name: count
fields.notes: 10; skipped by the reader (count fixed in the executable). Keep it unchanged.

fields.name: sharpshooterBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 20 (Trickster - Sharpshooter).

fields.name: masterSwordsmanBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 21 (Gilgamesh - Master Swordsman).

fields.name: lordOfTheKingsBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 22 (Behemoth King - Lord of the Kings).

fields.name: wyrmslayerBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 23 (Fafnir - Wyrmslayer).

fields.name: freshmakerBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 24 (Carrot - Freshmaker).

fields.name: eagleEyeBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 25 (Deathgaze - Eagle Eye).

fields.name: hunterExtraordinaireBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 26 (Yiazmat - Hunter Extraordinaire).

fields.name: radiantSaviorBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 27 (Hell Wyrm - Radiant Savior).

fields.name: fellAngelBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 28 (Ultima - Fell Angel).

fields.name: zodiacKnightBestiaryId
fields.notes: Bestiary entry of the foe whose defeat awards figure 29 (Zodiark - Zodiac Knight).

fields.name: endLink
fields.notes: Distance from this u16 to the end of data before the final 16-byte padding; = 8 + 4*(set bits in presenceMask).

fields.name: count
fields.notes: Unreliable in vanilla (the reader counts mask bits instead). Keep the stored value.

fields.name: presenceMask

bits.name: lordOfTheKingsHasParameter
bits.notes: Figure 22: Behemoth King - Lord of the Kings

fields.notes: Bit i set = figure i has an s32 parameter; parameters follow in increasing bit order.

records.name: hcomgFigureParameter
records.where: P + 8; the k-th set bit of presenceMask (from bit 0 up) owns the value at P + 8 + 4*k; file then zero-padded to 16
records.count: number of set bits in hcomgFigureBlockHeader.presenceMask

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Per-figure threshold; meaning and unit depend on the figure (unverified).

SkyPiratesDenFigure.22: Behemoth King - Lord of the Kings

roundTrip: Keep cartographerMapCount (384), the defeated-foe count (10), the Scrivener unused word and the figure-block count as stored; the reference writer recomputes the figure count, which differs from some vanilla files.
Map bits are least significant bit first; all 384 bits always present.
Figure parameters are written in increasing bit order of presenceMask.

After editing list lengths recompute: ruleCount and huntBlockLink (8 + 4n); huntCount and defeatedFoeBlockLink (align4(4 + 2n)); endLink (8 + 4m); then zero-pad the file to 16. scrivenerBlockLink (0x34) and figureBlockLink (24) do not change.
Hunt list padding and end-of-file padding are zero bytes.
